sentences.en: The garden needs regular aeration to keep the soil healthy.
sentences.zh: 花园需要定期松土以保持土壤健康。

sentences.en: Proper aeration is important for your home’s heating system.
sentences.zh: 正确的通风对家里的供暖系统很重要。

sentences.en: Aeration can help prevent waterlogging in rice fields.
sentences.zh: 在稻田里进行通风可以帮助防止积水。
